description.narrative: Ghana - Transportation Project - Trunk Roads Activity: the Improvements of Trunk Roads ("Trunk Roads Activity") will support the assessment and subsequent improvements of approximately 75 km of trunk roads. In addition, MCC Funding will support the design and preparation of bidding documentation for the rehabilitation or upgrade of approximately an additional 169 km of trunk roads in the Intervention Zones. MCC Funding will support the following: (i) Improvements to Agogo - Dome Road (75 km). (ii) (1) A technical and environmental audit of the Agogo - Dome Road (75 km) to assess the impact of recent rehabilitation activities; (2) Feasibility and design studies; (3) Implementation of the environmental and social mitigation measures; and (4) Project management, supervision and auditing of such improvements and upgrades.

condition.narrative: Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.

Prior to any MCC Disbursement for the Trunk Roads Activity: MiDA has selected and engaged an Implementing Entity under an Implementing Entity Agreement, and the agreement remains in full force and effect.

Prior to any MCC Disbursement with respect to any construction under the Trunk Roads Activity: MiDA has selected and engaged a firm to supervise the construction activities under the Trunk Roads Activity, approved by MCC, or in the event that such position is vacated, MiDA is actively recruiting for such position.

Prior to the initial MCC Disbursement with respect to any construction on the Agogo-Dome Road segment under the Trunk Roads Activity: MiDA has submitted a technical and environmental audit of the Agogo-Dome Road, completed to MCC's satisfaction.
